name: University of Turku
summary: Finland's second-largest university, in its oldest city; two English bachelor's degrees, sustainable business and a 3+2 ICT engineering track.

ib.text: IB holders go in admission group II, scored on their IB grades, so no SAT is needed. An IB Diploma completed in English, English A, or English B at 5 proves your English.

dates.label: Conditionally admitted: proof of graduation must reach Turku

programmes.name: Bachelor's Degree Programme in Sustainable and Social Entrepreneurship
programmes.ib: Only 30% of places go to certificate-based (IB) applicants; 70% go to SAT applicants.

programmes.name: Degree Programme in Information and Communication Technology
programmes.ib: 40% of places are certificate-based, scored on the technology table; you need advanced maths at a grade comparable to C in the Finnish exam.

notes: You can apply to at most three Turku programmes in one joint application.
Turku has not yet published its 2027 deadline for IB predicted grades; in the 2026 round it was 31 March, a day earlier than most Finnish universities.
The ICT degree admits you to a 3+2 bachelor's and master's in Turku without a second application.
